हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: After surviving a life-altering betrayal, Anant travels back three years to rewrite his history. He thwarts a murder plot orchestrated by his wife, Sonia, and his driver, Mayank, by turning their own scheme against them. Anant systematically strips Sonia of her status and wealth while exposing the greed of her sisters. The story ends with Anant finding true love with Kritika, while his betrayers face total ruin, madness, and imprisonment.
